context_snapshot.challenge: A support team spends time reconstructing context before approving service changes.
context_snapshot.desired_outcome: Reduce rework while preserving accountable human approval.
context_snapshot.work_system_boundary: Request intake, evidence review, decision approval, and handoff to the service owner.
facts: The service owner retains final approval
assumptions: Repeated context gathering is caused by inconsistent intake and handoff fields
unknowns: Which fields create the most rework
Whether a shorter approval packet is trusted

candidate_use_cases.title: Evidence-linked request packet
candidate_use_cases.workflow_change: AI drafts a standard request packet from authorized material; the analyst and service owner approve readiness and decision status.
candidate_use_cases.human_role: Check evidence, resolve ambiguity, and approve the request or send it back.
candidate_use_cases.ai_role: Extract context, identify missing fields, and link claims to source material.

impact.reason: Improves decision readiness and handoff quality.

inclusion.reason: A structured correction path helps requesters who use different formats.

tradeoffs: Adds a review step before approval
risks: A polished packet could hide weak evidence
evidence_gaps: No baseline for rework by request type
candidate_use_cases.non_ai_alternative: Use a shared intake and approval template with mandatory evidence links.

candidate_use_cases.title: Request triage board
candidate_use_cases.workflow_change: A weekly human review groups requests by decision readiness and assigns the next owner.
candidate_use_cases.human_role: Set thresholds, prioritize requests, and make the final assignment.
candidate_use_cases.ai_role: Optional sorting and duplicate detection after the process is stable.

productivity.reason: Makes queues visible but still needs manual review.

impact.reason: May reduce waiting if thresholds are clear.

inclusion.reason: A transparent queue can expose who is waiting and why.

risks: Visible queues may be mistaken for objective priority
candidate_use_cases.non_ai_alternative: Run the board manually with a fixed readiness checklist.

recommendation.why_now: It addresses the earliest rework point and can be tested without production integration.
recommendation.why_not_others_first: A triage board depends on consistent request evidence and readiness definitions.
recommendation.key_uncertainty: Whether source links and a short approval packet reduce rework without reducing decision quality.
recommendation.next_safe_action: Run the redesigned packet on eight completed requests and compare review effort and rework.

mtuc.hypothesis: A source-linked packet with explicit readiness approval will reduce repeated context gathering while keeping final decisions with the service owner.
mtuc.scope: Eight low-risk completed requests from both intake channels; no production writes.
mtuc.data_boundary: Use authorized request records with personal details minimized; store drafts in the approved test folder.
mtuc.baseline: Record current number of clarification loops and analyst review time for the same requests.
success_signals: Every approved packet has source links
Decision quality is unchanged in owner review
go_criteria: Owner and requester accept the packet
revise_criteria: Errors cluster in one request type
A field creates more work than it removes
stop_criteria: A critical decision is based on an unsupported claim
mtuc.review_point: After eight requests and before any system integration

user_confirmed: No production writes for the test
ai_inferred: Inconsistent intake fields are a likely rework driver

next_decision: Confirm the eight-request sample and the owner's evidence-quality threshold.

routes.summary: Add a source-linked draft packet to the current flow.
routes.workflow_change: The analyst reviews an AI draft before sending the existing approval packet.
routes.efficiency_gain: Less time spent reconstructing repeated context.
routes.new_capability: Claims can be traced to request evidence.
routes.ai_role: Draft fields, links, and missing-field prompts.
risks: Polished drafts may create automation bias
routes.minimum_experiment: Draft packets for eight completed requests and compare with the current review process.

routes.summary: Move readiness and correction before owner approval.
routes.workflow_change: Requester and analyst resolve missing evidence in a shared checkpoint before the owner sees the packet.
routes.efficiency_gain: Fewer late clarification loops at the approval stage.
routes.new_capability: A visible readiness gate and correction history.
routes.human_role: Requester confirms context; analyst verifies; owner approves.
routes.ai_role: Flag missing fields and summarize unresolved questions.
risks: The extra checkpoint may delay simple requests
routes.minimum_experiment: Use the readiness checkpoint on four requests from each channel.

routes.summary: Create a decision-ready request service with evidence as the primary object.
routes.workflow_change: Requests become reusable evidence records that feed approval, handoff, and later learning.
routes.efficiency_gain: Reduces repeated intake across downstream decisions.
routes.human_role: Set evidence policy, approve decisions, and govern reuse.
routes.ai_role: Link related evidence and suggest reusable records after approval.
risks: A shared memory could expose context beyond its intended boundary
routes.minimum_experiment: Manually link approved packets for one request type before automating reuse.

success_conditions: Every material claim has a source
decision_gates.human_checkpoint: Analyst signs off on evidence links
decision_gates.next_action: Send the packet to requester and owner
decision_gates.u_turn_condition: A material claim lacks source support
decision_gates.exit_condition: All required evidence fields are complete

success_conditions: Owner can explain the decision basis
decision_gates.human_checkpoint: Owner records approval or return reason
decision_gates.u_turn_condition: Owner identifies an unresolved evidence gap
decision_gates.exit_condition: Approval or stop decision is recorded

repeat: Human approval is the stable accountability point
difference: Request work has a readiness gate; meeting work has a confirmation gate
surprise: A shorter packet increased correction quality when unknowns were explicit

evidence_ladder.label: observation
evidence_ladder.statement: Both cases require explicit human confirmation before commitment.

evidence_ladder.label: hypothesis
evidence_ladder.statement: Visible unknowns make human review faster and safer.

evidence_ladder.label: emerging_pattern
evidence_ladder.statement: Source-linked drafts are most useful at the boundary where work changes ownership.

meta_lab.delivery_asset: A reusable source-linked checkpoint template for the next low-risk experiment.
meta_lab.learning_asset: A pattern card: place explicit human confirmation at every commitment boundary.
